House rules

The rule sheet, readable

The full rules live right on this page instead of inside a PDF. The short version:

Match format

Three games, rally scoring to 21, no cap. Matches are called one hour after the scheduled start, whatever the score.

Coed rules

At least 1 girl and no more than 2 guys on the court, and on three contacts a girl must touch the ball. One A-level male per team, no AA.

Work teams

Each team keeps score and oversees matches when listed as the work team. Skip your shift and it costs your team a match's worth of games.

Late arrivals

Not ready 10 minutes after start forfeits game 1, then game 2 at 20 minutes and game 3 at 30.

Playoffs

Top 6 teams make it, best of 3. Play at least 3 matches in the regular season to be eligible.

Rainouts

Matches only cancel for unsafe conditions. Captains get an email or text one hour before the first match, and the rainout banner goes up here.

Grab your spot on the sand

Leagues fill by the night. Registration for the 2027 season opens March 1, and the free-agent list is always open.

Schedule builder

Every team plays every week across courts 1 and 2, works a fair share of games, and never works a game while playing. Publishing pushes it to the league page, the calendar, and every My Team page. Blind draw leagues build the same way from a list of player names. An odd team count gets a rotating bye, and the bye team joins the working rotation. The same team is never put on both courts at once, and nobody works two games in a night unless the numbers force it. After the last week, the top 6 playoff bracket builds itself from the standings.
